executiveSummary: Marcus Chen (Acme Logistics, Enterprise) was double-billed $18,400 after a failed self-serve downgrade from Scale to Growth. Finance auto-retry compounded the charge. Sentiment is severely negative; he has opened a chargeback intent and asked for a same-day credit plus written confirmation. rawTranscript:
Agent: Hi Marcus, thanks for contacting OmniBrief Support. How can I help?
Marcus: This is the third time I've called. Your system charged my company twice — eighteen thousand four hundred dollars — when I tried to downgrade our plan. That money left our operating account this morning.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I confirm the account email?
Marcus: marcus.chen@acmelogistics.com. Ticket ESC-48291. Look, I've already spoken to two agents who said they'd escalate. Nobody called back. Our CFO is furious. If this isn't reversed today I'm filing a dispute with the bank and looping in our counsel.
Agent: I understand the urgency. Let me pull up the billing events…
Marcus: Don't make me wait on hold again. I need a credit issued now, the plan fixed to Growth, and something in writing. We've paid you $240K this year and this is how we're treated?
